messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — Opal cohort onboarding for Cobalt Health starts next Tue. I'm coordinating enrollment + feedback loop. Need to confirm SSO, data access, and an enablement slot. TL;DR: scheduling ask + a couple risks.

Jon Kim: Got it. Who from Cobalt will own SSO? Do we have their IdP metadata yet?

Maya Patel: Lee (Cobalt) said they'll send IdP metadata by EOD Fri. @Priya can you hold the SSO slot Tue 10am PT for the joint setup?

Priya Singh: Yes I can — Tue 10 works. I'll prep the SAML checklist and send steps (short checklist + exact fields we need).

Sam Rivera: I'll handle dataset access and sample prompt vetting. Need S3 creds + 2 sample prompts from prod. @Lee can you share those?

Lee Chong: Sharing now — uploading sample_prompts.zip to our secure link: https://cobalt-files.example/samples. ETA ~30m.

Maya Patel: Thanks Lee :thumbsup: Also adding a short survey we'll push on day 3 for qualitative feedback — draft here: https://forms.gle/example. @Sam can you review the questions for model-quality metrics?

Sam Rivera: On it. Also flag: Cobalt's renewal is in ~10 months; if onboarding fizzles we risk not converting. Suggest weekly 30m check-ins for first 6 weeks to keep momentum.

Priya Singh: Agreed. I'll create the calendar series and invite ops + product + Lee.

Maya Patel: enroll-bot: create 'opal-onboard' workspace and invite participants.

enroll-bot: Workspace 'opal-onboard' created. Channel #opal-cobalt created. Invite links sent.

Jon Kim: Any blockers for token access/limits? They want streaming enabled and lower per-token latency for demos.

Sam Rivera: We need to enable streaming on their dedicated scope and add a small burst limit. I'll open a ticket with eng-runtime. @Jon can you prioritize?

Jon Kim: Opening ticket ENG-4578 now — added details about streaming, burst caps, and SLA note.

Maya Patel: Action items recap: 1) Priya — create calendar + SAML checklist; 2) Sam — handle data transfers + model prompts; 3) Jon — open ENG ticket (ENG-4578); 4) Lee — upload IdP & confirm participants; 5) Maya — finalize day-3 feedback survey. I'll follow up Fri EOD with status. Anything else?

Lee Chong: All good from Cobalt. Quick Q — can we get a short enablement recording (10–12 min) geared to non-technical stakeholders after the SSO session?

Priya Singh: Yes — I'll record a 10-min walkthrough after the SSO session and drop it in #opal-cobalt. Will include a 2-slide TL;DR for execs.

Sam Rivera: :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll schedule an internal pre-call Thurs to align on talking points. Thanks everyone — will update thread when IdP + prompts land.
